issues.concern: The main gloss is too narrow and doesn't cover all senses, especially the 'make/establish' sense.
issues.suggestion: to stand up, to erect, to make, to establish

issues.concern: The English translation 'Hold up a finger' is too specific and doesn't fully capture the nuance of '指を立てる' which can also mean to point or to put a finger up (e.g., to count).
